formula.raw_force: F(t) = (close[t] - close[t-1]) * w(t), with w(t) = volume[t] when volume_weighting = 1 and w(t) = 1 when volume_weighting = 0 (the ablation)
formula.fixed_length_recursion: for every timestamp t: e = F(t - L + 1); for k = t - L + 2 .. t in order: e = alpha * F(k) + (1 - alpha) * e, with alpha = 2 / (force_period + 1) and L = recursion_length. EF(t) = e. Every bar restarts from its own seed, so EF(t) reads only closes[t-L .. t] (L + 1 closes)
formula.difference_from_unrestricted_ema: an unrestricted EMA starts once at the first raw-force value of the frame and carries all older history, so its value depends on where the frame starts; the fixed-length value forgets everything older than L raw-force values and is the same in any frame that contains them
formula.trend_sma: SMA(t) = mean(close[t - trend_period + 1 .. t]), summed in index order from each endpoint's own window
formula.uptrend: U(t) = close[t] > SMA(t) and SMA(t) > SMA(t - slope_span) (both strict)
formula.downtrend: D(t) = close[t] < SMA(t) and SMA(t) < SMA(t - slope_span) (both strict)
formula.long_entry: EF(t-1) < 0 and EF(t) > 0 and U(t-1) and U(t) and volume[t-1] > 0 and volume[t] > 0
formula.short_entry: EF(t-1) > 0 and EF(t) < 0 and D(t-1) and D(t) and volume[t-1] > 0 and volume[t] > 0
formula.zero: EF exactly zero on either crossing candle never triggers; constant closes give zero force
formula.volume_eligibility: both crossing candles need positive supplied volume in both variants, so eligibility is identical; an older zero-volume candle contributes zero raw force when weighted and the close change in the ablation
formula.required_history: max(L + 2, trend_period + slope_span + 1) rows: a crossing at t reads EF(t-1), which needs closes[t-1-L .. t-1]; the trend test at t and t-1 needs SMA(t-1-slope_span). 152 rows at the seed parameters, at most 199
formula.validity: a decision is made only when every row of its own required span has finite open, high, low, close and volume, positive prices, low <= open, close <= high, volume >= 0, a timestamp, no received-order defect, and every internal timestamp edge equals the declared bar cadence; EF, SMA and their lagged values must be finite (overflow holds); anything else holds with a reason code
formula.cadence: read from the closed_bar frame attributes bar_interval_ms and bar_timestamp_kind; a frame without a declared cadence holds every bar
formula.volume_units: supplied venue volume (Hyperliquid candleSnapshot v, base-asset units); aggressor direction is never inferred from candle colour

elder_force_pullback_vw0.note: volume ablation: the candidate's selected parameters with volume_weighting 0; never selected separately

selection.eligible: complete candle and funding coverage, every dataset scored, no liquidated leg, at least min_train_independent_positions independent positions

reference_tolerance.role: fixed-length force and trend SMA against an independent scalar reference

sensitivity.normalized_difference: abs(EF_fixed(t) - EF_unrestricted(t)) / max(1, max abs raw force over the rows the unrestricted average has read up to t)
sensitivity.unrestricted: one EMA seeded at the first raw-force value of the full frozen series and updated on every later row
sensitivity.role: descriptive; reports the largest normalized and absolute differences and every changed sign or entry decision; it does not change the finite signal contract

uncertainty.method: percentile bootstrap of the mean net PnL per closed position, pooled over datasets
uncertainty.role: descriptive only; positions overlap in time and are not independent, so the interval is optimistic and never a verdict input

base.meaning: manifest fees, per-coin half spread and slippage

stress.meaning: manifest fees unchanged, half spread and slippage doubled

verdict.inconclusive: any coverage refusal, funding-incomplete leg, no eligible training selection for a selected arm, or a held-out sample gate that fails
verdict.pass: complete coverage, every sample gate met, candidate net PnL > 0 at base and stress cost, candidate base mean Sharpe and base mean drawdown-adjusted return both strictly above each comparator (volume ablation, momentum_pro, elder_ray_pullback)
verdict.fail: a complete study that misses any pass condition
verdict.edge_status: no_edge for every outcome; a pass never approves live edge
